`final class MsdfTextRenderer`<br/>
**Extends:** [`GlyphTextRenderer<MsdfFontFace>`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MsdfTextRenderer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/MsdfTextRenderer.java)

The text renderer of every `MsdfFont`, which draws each glyph from the distance field of its face.

## Description

You never call it yourself: [`MsdfFont.getTextRenderer`](/reference/text/msdffont/#MsdfFont-method-getTextRenderer) returns it to [`DrawText`](/reference/text/drawtext/).
It draws each glyph as a quad of the atlas through the font shader of JOID; the baseline snaps to the pixel grid so that a line keeps the same sharpness wherever it sits.
